objective: Run the frozen Stage 14C-4/14C-5 cleaned F2 method on all 15 Stage 14B Known-only protocols and compare paired Known-Validation metrics with existing Native Open-Detect results.

changes: Added an isolated Stage 14C-6 wrapper that imports the immutable Stage 14C-4 optimization primitives and generalizes execution to all 15 frozen protocols.
Added preflight, four-GPU queue, aggregation, report, and completion-verification scripts inside the Stage 14C-6 bundle.
Did not modify Stage 14B, Stage 14C-4, Stage 14C.5, or Native Open-Detect artifacts.

parameters.checkpoint_selection: highest harmonic mean of Known Validation Accuracy and Macro-F1

limitations: Known Validation only; no Known Test or Unknown-detection claim is made.
Native uses its frozen fixed-2022 training seed while Our-Cleaned uses protocol seeds, so the comparison is paired by protocol/data but not a single-seed architecture ablation.
Known-class composition associations are descriptive and confounded by joint class changes.
rdp has validation support four in several protocols, producing high-variance class estimates.
next_step: The cleaned pipeline may be frozen and used in a separately frozen open-set evaluation; no open-set evaluation was started here.
